**Describe the bug** Hi, we run `argocd app diff --revision ` in our CI and some jobs fail with the following missing permissions error: ```json { "level": "fatal", "msg": "rpc error: code = Unknown desc = error performing state diffs: failed to calculate diff: error calculating server side diff: serverSideDiff error: error running server side apply in dryrun mode for resource ClusterRole/cert-manager-cainjector: clusterroles.rbac.authorization.k8s.io "cert-manager-cainjector" is forbidden: user "system:serviceaccount:argocd:argocd-server" (groups=["system:serviceaccounts" "system:serviceaccounts:argocd" "system:authenticated"]) is attempting to grant RBAC permissions not currently held:%0A{APIGroups:[""], Resources:["events"], Verbs:["update"]}%0A{APIGroups:[""], Resources:["secrets"], Verbs:["list" "watch"]}%0A{APIGroups:["admissionregistration.k8s.io"], Resources:["mutatingwebhookconfigurations"], Verbs:["list" "watch" "update"]}%0A{APIGroups:["admissionregistration.k8s.io"], Resources:["validatingwebhookconfigurations"], Verbs:["list" "watch" "update"]}%0A{APIGroups:["apiextensions.k8s.io"], Resources:["customresourcedefinitions"], Verbs:["list" "watch" "update"]}%0A{APIGroups:["apiregistration.k8s.io"], Resources:["apiservices"], Verbs:["list" "watch" "update"]}%0A{APIGroups:["cert-manager.io"], Resources:["certificates"], Verbs:["list" "watch"]}", "time": "2026-02-05T11:06:03+01:00", } ``` **To Reproduce** Application: ```yaml apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1 kind: Application metadata: annotations: argocd.argoproj.io/compare-options: ServerSideDiff=true,IncludeMutationWebhook=true argocd.argoproj.io/manifest-generate-paths: ./.. name: cert-manager namespace: argocd spec: destination: name: in-cluster namespace: cert-manager project: default source: helm: releaseName: cert-manager valueFiles: - ../values-common.yaml - ./values.yaml path: cert-manager/my-cluster repoURL: https://gitlab.com/org/repo.git targetRevision: HEAD syncPolicy: automated: prune: true selfHeal: true managedNamespaceMetadata: labels: app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: argocd protected: "true" retry: refresh: true syncOptions: - CreateNamespace=true - FailOnSharedResource=true - PruneLast=true - ServerSideApply=true ``` > The targeted path is just referencing the cert-manager chart as a dependency: ```yaml apiVersion: v2 name: cert-manager version: 1.0.0 dependencies: - name: cert-manager version: v1.19.1 repository: https://charts.jetstack.io ``` **Expected behavior** ArgoCD Application Controller service account used to produce the diff to avoid this failure. **Screenshots** The diff is working partially: Platform: linux/amd64 Kustomize Version: v5.8.0 2025-11-09T14:39:49Z Helm Version: v3.19.4+g7cfb6e4 Kubectl Version: v0.34.0 Jsonnet Version: v0.21.0 ```
title: ArgoCD server-side diff fail with missing permissions error
